verses.GEN 6:13: And God said unto Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me; for the earth is filled with violence through them; and, behold, I will destroy them with the earth.

verses.GEN 6:15: And this is the fashion which thou shalt make it of: The length of the ark shall be three hundred cubits, the breadth of it fifty cubits, and the height of it thirty cubits.
verses.GEN 6:16: A window shalt thou make to the ark, and in a cubit shalt thou finish it above; and the door of the ark shalt thou set in the side thereof; with lower, second, and third stories shalt thou make it.
verses.GEN 6:17: And, behold, I, even I, do bring a flood of waters upon the earth, to destroy all flesh, wherein is the breath of life, from under heaven; and every thing that is in the earth shall die.
verses.GEN 6:18: But with thee will I establish my covenant; and thou shalt come into the ark, thou, and thy sons, and thy wife, and thy sons’ wives with thee.
verses.GEN 6:19: And of every living thing of all flesh, two of every sort shalt thou bring into the ark, to keep them alive with thee; they shall be male and female.
verses.GEN 6:20: Of fowls after their kind, and of cattle after their kind, of every creeping thing of the earth after his kind, two of every sort shall come unto thee, to keep them alive.
verses.GEN 6:21: And take thou unto thee of all food that is eaten, and thou shalt gather it to thee; and it shall be for food for thee, and for them.
verses.GEN 6:22: Thus did Noah; according to all that God commanded him, so did he.
verses.GEN 7:17: And the flood was forty days upon the earth; and the waters increased, and bare up the ark, and it was lift up above the earth.
verses.GEN 7:18: And the waters prevailed, and were increased greatly upon the earth; and the ark went upon the face of the waters.
verses.GEN 8:6: And it came to pass at the end of forty days, that Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made:
verses.GEN 8:7: And he sent forth a raven, which went forth to and fro, until the waters were dried up from off the earth.
verses.GEN 8:8: Also he sent forth a dove from him, to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground;
verses.GEN 8:9: But the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot, and she returned unto him into the ark, for the waters were on the face of the whole earth: then he put forth his hand, and took her, and pulled her in unto him into the ark.
verses.GEN 8:10: And he stayed yet other seven days; and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark;
verses.GEN 8:11: And the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth was an olive leaf pluckt off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.
verses.GEN 8:12: And he stayed yet other seven days; and sent forth the dove; which returned not again unto him any more.

verses.GEN 9:14: And it shall come to pass, when I bring a cloud over the earth, that the bow shall be seen in the cloud:

verses.EXO 14:10: And when Pharaoh drew nigh, the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and, behold, the Egyptians marched after them; and they were sore afraid: and the children of Israel cried out unto the LORD.
verses.EXO 14:11: And they said unto Moses, Because there were no graves in Egypt, hast thou taken us away to die in the wilderness? wherefore hast thou dealt thus with us, to carry us forth out of Egypt?
verses.EXO 14:12: Is not this the word that we did tell thee in Egypt, saying, Let us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians? For it had been better for us to serve the Egyptians, than that we should die in the wilderness.
verses.EXO 14:13: And Moses said unto the people, Fear ye not, stand still, and see the salvation of the LORD, which he will shew to you to day: for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day, ye shall see them again no more for ever.
verses.EXO 14:14: The LORD shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.
verses.EXO 14:15: And the LORD said unto Moses, Wherefore criest thou unto me? speak unto the children of Israel, that they go forward:
verses.EXO 14:16: But lift thou up thy rod, and stretch out thine hand over the sea, and divide it: and the children of Israel shall go on dry ground through the midst of the sea.
verses.EXO 14:21: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and the LORD caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.
verses.EXO 14:22: And the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground: and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.
verses.EXO 14:26: And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand over the sea, that the waters may come again upon the Egyptians, upon their chariots, and upon their horsemen.
verses.EXO 14:27: And Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to his strength when the morning appeared; and the Egyptians fled against it; and the LORD overthrew the Egyptians in the midst of the sea.
verses.EXO 14:28: And the waters returned, and covered the chariots, and the horsemen, and all the host of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them; there remained not so much as one of them.
verses.EXO 14:29: But the children of Israel walked upon dry land in the midst of the sea; and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.
verses.EXO 14:30: Thus the LORD saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore.
verses.EXO 14:31: And Israel saw that great work which the LORD did upon the Egyptians: and the people feared the LORD, and believed the LORD, and his servant Moses.
verses.RUT 1:6: Then she arose with her daughters in law, that she might return from the country of Moab: for she had heard in the country of Moab how that the LORD had visited his people in giving them bread.
verses.RUT 1:7: Wherefore she went forth out of the place where she was, and her two daughters in law with her; and they went on the way to return unto the land of Judah.
verses.RUT 1:8: And Naomi said unto her two daughters in law, Go, return each to her mother’s house: the LORD deal kindly with you, as ye have dealt with the dead, and with me.
verses.RUT 1:9: The LORD grant you that ye may find rest, each of you in the house of her husband. Then she kissed them; and they lifted up their voice, and wept.
verses.RUT 1:10: And they said unto her, Surely we will return with thee unto thy people.
verses.RUT 1:11: And Naomi said, Turn again, my daughters: why will ye go with me? are there yet any more sons in my womb, that they may be your husbands?
verses.RUT 1:12: Turn again, my daughters, go your way; for I am too old to have an husband. If I should say, I have hope, if I should have an husband also to night, and should also bear sons;
verses.RUT 1:13: Would ye tarry for them till they were grown? would ye stay for them from having husbands? nay, my daughters; for it grieveth me much for your sakes that the hand of the LORD is gone out against me.
verses.RUT 1:14: And they lifted up their voice, and wept again: and Orpah kissed her mother in law; but Ruth clave unto her.
verses.RUT 1:15: And she said, Behold, thy sister in law is gone back unto her people, and unto her gods: return thou after thy sister in law.
verses.RUT 1:16: And Ruth said, Intreat me not to leave thee, or to return from following after thee: for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge: thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God:
verses.RUT 1:17: Where thou diest, will I die, and there will I be buried: the LORD do so to me, and more also, if ought but death part thee and me.

verses.1SA 17:4: And there went out a champion out of the camp of the Philistines, named Goliath, of Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span.

verses.1SA 17:6: And he had greaves of brass upon his legs, and a target of brass between his shoulders.
verses.1SA 17:7: And the staff of his spear was like a weaver’s beam; and his spear’s head weighed six hundred shekels of iron: and one bearing a shield went before him.
verses.1SA 17:8: And he stood and cried unto the armies of Israel, and said unto them, Why are ye come out to set your battle in array? am not I a Philistine, and ye servants to Saul? choose you a man for you, and let him come down to me.
verses.1SA 17:9: If he be able to fight with me, and to kill me, then will we be your servants: but if I prevail against him, and kill him, then shall ye be our servants, and serve us.
verses.1SA 17:10: And the Philistine said, I defy the armies of Israel this day; give me a man, that we may fight together.
verses.1SA 17:11: When Saul and all Israel heard those words of the Philistine, they were dismayed, and greatly afraid.

verses.1SA 17:34: And David said unto Saul, Thy servant kept his father’s sheep, and there came a lion, and a bear, and took a lamb out of the flock:
verses.1SA 17:35: And I went out after him, and smote him, and delivered it out of his mouth: and when he arose against me, I caught him by his beard, and smote him, and slew him.
verses.1SA 17:36: Thy servant slew both the lion and the bear: and this uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them, seeing he hath defied the armies of the living God.
verses.1SA 17:37: David said moreover, The LORD that delivered me out of the paw of the lion, and out of the paw of the bear, he will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine. And Saul said unto David, Go, and the LORD be with thee.

verses.1SA 17:41: And the Philistine came on and drew near unto David; and the man that bare the shield went before him.
verses.1SA 17:42: And when the Philistine looked about, and saw David, he disdained him: for he was but a youth, and ruddy, and of a fair countenance.
verses.1SA 17:43: And the Philistine said unto David, Am I a dog, that thou comest to me with staves? And the Philistine cursed David by his gods.

verses.1SA 17:45: Then said David to the Philistine, Thou comest to me with a sword, and with a spear, and with a shield: but I come to thee in the name of the LORD of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom thou hast defied.
verses.1SA 17:46: This day will the LORD deliver thee into mine hand; and I will smite thee, and take thine head from thee; and I will give the carcases of the host of the Philistines this day unto the fowls of the air, and to the wild beasts of the earth; that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel.
verses.1SA 17:47: And all this assembly shall know that the LORD saveth not with sword and spear: for the battle is the LORD’s, and he will give you into our hands.
verses.1SA 17:48: And it came to pass, when the Philistine arose, and came and drew nigh to meet David, that David hasted, and ran toward the army to meet the Philistine.
verses.1SA 17:49: And David put his hand in his bag, and took thence a stone, and slang it, and smote the Philistine in his forehead, that the stone sunk into his forehead; and he fell upon his face to the earth.
verses.1SA 17:50: So David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and with a stone, and smote the Philistine, and slew him; but there was no sword in the hand of David.

verses.DAN 6:21: Then said Daniel unto the king, O king, live for ever.
verses.DAN 6:22: My God hath sent his angel, and hath shut the lions’ mouths, that they have not hurt me: forasmuch as before him innocency was found in me; and also before thee, O king, have I done no hurt.
verses.DAN 6:23: Then was the king exceeding glad for him, and commanded that they should take Daniel up out of the den. So Daniel was taken up out of the den, and no manner of hurt was found upon him, because he believed in his God.

verses.JON 3:2: Arise, go unto Nineveh, that great city, and preach unto it the preaching that I bid thee.

verses.JON 3:4: And Jonah began to enter into the city a day’s journey, and he cried, and said, Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown.

verses.LUK 10:25: And, behold, a certain lawyer stood up, and tempted him, saying, Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
verses.LUK 10:26: He said unto him, What is written in the law? how readest thou?
verses.LUK 10:27: And he answering said, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy strength, and with all thy mind; and thy neighbour as thyself.
verses.LUK 10:28: And he said unto him, Thou hast answered right: this do, and thou shalt live.
verses.LUK 10:29: But he, willing to justify himself, said unto Jesus, And who is my neighbour?
verses.LUK 10:30: And Jesus answering said, A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among thieves, which stripped him of his raiment, and wounded him, and departed, leaving him half dead.
verses.LUK 10:31: And by chance there came down a certain priest that way: and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
verses.LUK 10:32: And likewise a Levite, when he was at the place, came and looked on him, and passed by on the other side.
verses.LUK 10:33: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he had compassion on him,
verses.LUK 10:34: And went to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring in oil and wine, and set him on his own beast, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
verses.LUK 10:35: And on the morrow when he departed, he took out two pence, and gave them to the host, and said unto him, Take care of him; and whatsoever thou spendest more, when I come again, I will repay thee.
verses.LUK 10:36: Which now of these three, thinkest thou, was neighbour unto him that fell among the thieves?
verses.LUK 10:37: And he said, He that shewed mercy on him. Then said Jesus unto him, Go, and do thou likewise.
verses.LUK 15:3: And he spake this parable unto them, saying,
verses.LUK 15:4: What man of you, having an hundred sheep, if he lose one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he find it?
verses.LUK 15:5: And when he hath found it, he layeth it on his shoulders, rejoicing.
verses.LUK 15:6: And when he cometh home, he calleth together his friends and neighbours, saying unto them, Rejoice with me; for I have found my sheep which was lost.
verses.LUK 15:7: I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.
verses.LUK 15:11: And he said, A certain man had two sons:
verses.LUK 15:12: And the younger of them said to his father, Father, give me the portion of goods that falleth to me. And he divided unto them his living.
verses.LUK 15:13: And not many days after the younger son gathered all together, and took his journey into a far country, and there wasted his substance with riotous living.
verses.LUK 15:14: And when he had spent all, there arose a mighty famine in that land; and he began to be in want.
verses.LUK 15:15: And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine.
verses.LUK 15:16: And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat: and no man gave unto him.
verses.LUK 15:17: And when he came to himself, he said, How many hired servants of my father’s have bread enough and to spare, and I perish with hunger!
verses.LUK 15:18: I will arise and go to my father, and will say unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and before thee,
verses.LUK 15:19: And am no more worthy to be called thy son: make me as one of thy hired servants.
verses.LUK 15:20: And he arose, and came to his father. But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him, and had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.
verses.LUK 15:21: And the son said unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in thy sight, and am no more worthy to be called thy son.
verses.LUK 15:22: But the father said to his servants, Bring forth the best robe, and put it on him; and put a ring on his hand, and shoes on his feet:
verses.LUK 15:23: And bring hither the fatted calf, and kill it; and let us eat, and be merry:
verses.LUK 15:24: For this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found. And they began to be merry.
verses.LUK 15:25: Now his elder son was in the field: and as he came and drew nigh to the house, he heard musick and dancing.
verses.LUK 15:26: And he called one of the servants, and asked what these things meant.
verses.LUK 15:27: And he said unto him, Thy brother is come; and thy father hath killed the fatted calf, because he hath received him safe and sound.
verses.LUK 15:28: And he was angry, and would not go in: therefore came his father out, and intreated him.
verses.LUK 15:29: And he answering said to his father, Lo, these many years do I serve thee, neither transgressed I at any time thy commandment: and yet thou never gavest me a kid, that I might make merry with my friends:
verses.LUK 15:30: But as soon as this thy son was come, which hath devoured thy living with harlots, thou hast killed for him the fatted calf.
verses.LUK 15:31: And he said unto him, Son, thou art ever with me, and all that I have is thine.
verses.LUK 15:32: It was meet that we should make merry, and be glad: for this thy brother was dead, and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.
verses.LUK 19:1: And Jesus entered and passed through Jericho.
verses.LUK 19:2: And, behold, there was a man named Zacchæus, which was the chief among the publicans, and he was rich.
verses.LUK 19:3: And he sought to see Jesus who he was; and could not for the press, because he was little of stature.
verses.LUK 19:4: And he ran before, and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him: for he was to pass that way.
verses.LUK 19:5: And when Jesus came to the place, he looked up, and saw him, and said unto him, Zacchæus, make haste, and come down; for to day I must abide at thy house.
verses.LUK 19:6: And he made haste, and came down, and received him joyfully.
verses.LUK 19:7: And when they saw it, they all murmured, saying, That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner.
verses.LUK 19:8: And Zacchæus stood, and said unto the Lord; Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him fourfold.
verses.LUK 19:9: And Jesus said unto him, This day is salvation come to this house, forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham.
verses.MRK 10:46: And they came to Jericho: and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people, blind Bartimæus, the son of Timæus, sat by the highway side begging.
verses.MRK 10:47: And when he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out, and say, Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
verses.MRK 10:48: And many charged him that he should hold his peace: but he cried the more a great deal, Thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
verses.MRK 10:49: And Jesus stood still, and commanded him to be called. And they call the blind man, saying unto him, Be of good comfort, rise; he calleth thee.
verses.MRK 10:50: And he, casting away his garment, rose, and came to Jesus.
verses.MRK 10:51: And Jesus answered and said unto him, What wilt thou that I should do unto thee? The blind man said unto him, Lord, that I might receive my sight.
verses.MRK 10:52: And Jesus said unto him, Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole. And immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus in the way.
verses.JHN 11:32: Then when Mary was come where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
verses.JHN 11:33: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews also weeping which came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled,
verses.JHN 11:34: And said, Where have ye laid him? They said unto him, Lord, come and see.
verses.JHN 11:36: Then said the Jews, Behold how he loved him!
verses.JHN 11:37: And some of them said, Could not this man, which opened the eyes of the blind, have caused that even this man should not have died?
verses.JHN 11:38: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave. It was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.
verses.JHN 11:39: Jesus said, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time he stinketh: for he hath been dead four days.
verses.JHN 11:40: Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God?
verses.JHN 11:41: Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid. And Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me.
verses.JHN 11:42: And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the people which stand by I said it, that they may believe that thou hast sent me.
verses.JHN 11:43: And when he thus had spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.
verses.JHN 11:44: And he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with graveclothes: and his face was bound about with a napkin. Jesus saith unto them, Loose him, and let him go.
verses.MAT 28:1: In the end of the sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre.
verses.MAT 28:2: And, behold, there was a great earthquake: for the angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone from the door, and sat upon it.
verses.MAT 28:3: His countenance was like lightning, and his raiment white as snow:
verses.MAT 28:4: And for fear of him the keepers did shake, and became as dead men.
verses.MAT 28:5: And the angel answered and said unto the women, Fear not ye: for I know that ye seek Jesus, which was crucified.
verses.MAT 28:7: And go quickly, and tell his disciples that he is risen from the dead; and, behold, he goeth before you into Galilee; there shall ye see him: lo, I have told you.
verses.MAT 28:8: And they departed quickly from the sepulchre with fear and great joy; and did run to bring his disciples word.
verses.MAT 28:9: And as they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, All hail. And they came and held him by the feet, and worshipped him.
verses.MAT 28:10: Then said Jesus unto them, Be not afraid: go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee, and there shall they see me.
